v1AssociatedUser.description: A user associated with an account.

email.description: Output only. The user's email address.

firstName.description: Output only. The user's given name. Empty when the user has no name on file.

lastName.description: Output only. The user's family name. Empty when the user has no name on file.

phone.description:
Output only. The user's work phone number. Only phone numbers of type WORK
are returned; empty when the user has none.

profileImageUrl.description: Output only. The user's profile image URL; empty when unavailable.

userId.description:
Output only. The user's identifier, in the form `U-<uuid>`
(for example, `U-e3bbb42b-c464-4326-9c09-aa8cfc45e0b3`). Use this value
when referring to the user in other APIs, such as SCIM group membership.

v1AssociatedUser.title: Associated User

v1ListUsersForBusinessV2Request.description: Request message for listing the users associated with a single account, one page at a time.

accountGroupId.description:
Required. The account group whose associated users should be returned,
in the form `AG-XXXXXXXX`.

v1ListUsersForBusinessV2Request.title: List Users For Business Request

v1ListUsersForBusinessV2Response.description: One page of users associated with the requested account.

associatedUsers.description: Output only. The users associated with the account for this page of results.

v1ListUsersForBusinessV2Response.title: List Users For Business Response

cursor.description: Optional. An opaque token from a previous response's next_cursor to retrieve the next page of results. Omit or leave empty for the first page.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of items to return per page.

hasMore.title: Whether or not more results exist

nextCursor.title: A cursor that can be provided to retrieve the next page of results

totalResults.title: The total number of results. This is not supported on all paged apis and will be 0 if it is not supported

scopes.user: Allows the application to manage users in the platform
scopes.user.business: Allows the application to manage client business users, including creating them
scopes.user.business:read: Allows the application view-only access to the users associated to the business

post.description:
Returns the users associated with an account, one page at a time.

Pass `paging_options.cursor` from the previous response's `paging_metadata.next_cursor` to retrieve subsequent pages, and stop when `has_more` is false.

Required OAuth2 scopes: `user`, `user.business`, or `user.business:read`

requestBody.description: Request message for listing the users associated with a single account, one page at a time.

tags.description: Endpoints for reading the users associated with an account.
tags.name: Account Users
